page.layout: One page of text, single column, running head at top with page number at top right; below the text a dateline in italics, then a woodcut ornament; signature at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.p: ptima quæque etiam de nobis certò persuasum habeat. Cæterum suam Majestatem etiam atque etiam roga-mus, ut nos nostramque Reipubl. semper commendatam habere velit. Vicissim suæ Majestatis incolumita-tem, diu & feliciter florere ex animo cupimus. Magnifico autem Domino Segurio felicem in Patriam reditum exoptamus.
Lubecæ Calendas Martii Anno 1584. Stylo Antiquo.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the dateline is not transcribed as text. The signature "M 3" and the catchword "Ad" at the lower right are read as printed; "Ad" is doubtful. The words "Reg. Gall. ad Imp. &c." in the running head are read from the scan; "Reipubl." is printed in italics with a long-tailed p, so the reading is uncertain.
